title: 方块骑士Square Knight
description:
[About the game]

Hello everyone, I am an independent game developer from China. "Block Knight" is the first game I developed, and while it has many shortcomings, I am deeply grateful to all of you for playing it.

[Game Background]

The player will take on the role of a blocky character, searching for 12 scattered chocolates in various locations such as abandoned laboratories, underground forests, caves, and more.

[Core gameplay]

Players must collect chocolates through a series of puzzles and platform jumps, and uncover the secret abilities of the block knight through each bold move, in order to finally complete the game.

[Game Content]

The game lasts about 2 hours

More than 12 puzzle segments

Parkour segment

10 pieces of music
description_short: "Block Knight" is a platformer puzzle game where the only movement is left and right. In a hand-drawn world, players explore and discover the secret abilities of Block Knight, using these abilities to reach unexpected places and ultimately collect 12 chocolates to complete the game.
